# A check box and a radio button are checked by BM_SETCHECK and read back by
# BM_GETCHECK, and a control disabled is drawn grayed: the program sets each
# state, the snapshot shows it, and a check box's handler reads what Win32
# checked it to as the test presses it. Each is a Win32 call of
# sngl:platform/win32's own, through api's declarations, in every way a
# program calls C: from C, through Go's wrappers, from Go directly, and from
# C built for 32-bit Windows.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c states.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
exists states.sngl.snapshots/set.png
exists states.sngl.snapshots/flipped.png
! cmp states.sngl.snapshots/set.png states.sngl.snapshots/flipped.png

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go states.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct states.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c --opt arch=386 states.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- states.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var on = true
    var size = 1
    var off = true
    ui.vbox {
        ui.checkbox #flag(label="flag", checked=on, @change(v) { on = v })
        ui.radio #sizes(:value=size, disabled=off) {
            ui.choice(label="small", value=1)
            ui.choice(label="large", value=2)
        }
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click {
            on = !on
            size = 3 - size
            off = !off
        })
    }
}

ui.window(title="States") {
    main()
}

func testHandlersReadTheState(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.flag.change(false)
    t.assert(!c.on)
    c.flag.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on)
    c.sizes.change(2)
    t.assert(c.size == 2)
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("set")
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(!c.on)
    t.assert(c.size == 2)
    t.snapshot("flipped")
}
